name: zn15_35_parcellizable_region_highlight
description: Extra vector for ZQ2: CreateParcellizableRegion's 'occupied' test (§7.4) is the zone developer's per-cell IsCellOccupied, asked in highlight mode only (in highlight mode: a real lot that is not virtually deleted, or a virtual lot), and the lot then examined is always the real one, GetLot(x, z, false). The harness calls CreateParcellizableRegion directly; with 'highlight' it runs in highlight mode over the given virtual-lot and virtually deleted cells. Configuration 0x301 is compatible with the zone (the lot survives: keep := false), 0x302 is not (DeleteLot, keep := true). Six cells on z = 10, zone 1, the five rows of the §7.4 highlight table: A (10, 10) nothing -> keep, bit set; B (11, 10) a real lot (0x302) not virtually deleted -> occupied, examined, failing -> 'deleted', which in highlight mode only records a virtual deletion (§8.6), keep, bit set; C (12, 10) a real lot (0x301) not virtually deleted -> examined, survives, bit clear; D (13, 10) a real lot (0x301), virtually deleted, no virtual lot -> not occupied, not examined, keep, bit set (examining it would clear the bit); E (14, 10) a virtual lot only -> occupied, but the real lot is null, keep, bit set; F (15, 10) a virtually deleted real lot (0x301) and a virtual lot -> occupied, the real lot is examined again [quirk] and, compatible, clears the bit. Result {A, B, D, E}; virtually deleted afterwards {B, D, F}; no lot is really deleted (lot count 5). Real-mode control on the same cells: the lot test runs directly, B is really deleted (lot count 4, nothing recorded as virtually deleted), C, D and F survive: {A, B, E}. Last, the ZQ2 difference: in highlight mode with current zone 0, a cell G (16, 10) holding a road and a real lot (0x301) is not skipped (the network skip needs a zone other than 0); IsCellOccupied is true (a real lot, not virtually deleted), so the lot is examined and survives: bit clear. CanCreateLot(…) == 7 would have answered code 3 (network) there and kept the bit.

steps.note: highlight mode, zone 1: the five rows of the §7.4 table
highlight mode, zone 0: a road cell with a real lot is examined
